framework: OECD AI incident and hazard terminology
source_version: Defining AI incidents and related terms (6 May 2024)

entries.title: AI hazard
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR E0 and some E1/E2 events may align with potential-harm hazard concepts, subject to the OECD harm scope.

entries.title: AI incident
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR E3/E4 records with realized harm may align with the OECD actual-harm concept, subject to the OECD harm scope.

entries.title: Actual harm
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR realized harm is recorded separately from credible potential harm.

entries.title: Potential harm
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR potential harm supports hazard analysis even when realized harm is H0.
